box_selection_rule.conversion: cxcywh(normalised) -> xyxy -> scale by (W, H) -> clip to [0,W]x[0,H]
box_selection_rule.coordinate_space: absolute xyxy pixels in the original image
box_selection_rule.iou_target_criterion: proposal IoU with GT target >= 0.5 (unchanged from V1)
box_selection_rule.near_duplicate_handling: recorded only (redundancy stats); no result-driven NMS in the first version
box_selection_rule.same_category_assignment: proposal -> highest-IoU COCO GT object only if IoU >= 0.5 (unchanged from V1)

candidate_ordering.detr_confidence_ordering_role: The DETR foreground-score ranking is bank *provenance* only: it fixes the order in which the N=64 DETR proposals are stored at bank-generation time. It is NOT a Random candidate-selection rule and MUST NOT be used to pick the K5/K10/K20/K50 distractors.
candidate_ordering.primary_random_rule: target = canonical slot 0; the remaining eligible proposals are laid out by the exact V1 deterministic seeded-random per-ref shuffle (rng = default_rng([MANIFEST_SEED, ref_id])), and C_K = [target] + order[:K-1] gives nested prefixes for K5/K10/K20/K50 (C5 subset C10 subset C20 subset C50).
candidate_ordering.rationale: The proposal-family robustness test must change ONLY the proposal family while holding the candidate-construction regime fixed. Reusing the V1 seeded-random ordering keeps the DETR cohort directly comparable with the frozen RPN reference.
candidate_ordering.resolution: Supersedes the P1-F3 wording 'distractors ordered by DETR confidence': the primary Random regime follows the exact V1 seeded-random distractor construction (seed 20260927), never DETR confidence top-K. The P1-F3 run already used --regime random, so its Random-K5 numbers are consistent with this clarification.

no_result_driven_tuning: N, threshold, checkpoint, NMS, target-matching and same-category rules are frozen here; a gate failure is reported, never answered by tuning (sections 10/25).

preprocessing.batch_note: one image per forward call: the processor is aspect-preserving and, at batch=1, adds no padding, so normalised pred_boxes scale exactly to original pixels (inverse of post_process_object_detection).

proposal_a_reference.model: fasterrcnn_resnet50_fpn (COCO_V1) RPN stage, N=64, frozen, NOT regenerated

proposal_family: Proposal-B = frozen DETR-R50 (Proposal-A stays the frozen COCO RPN)

score_definition.foreground_columns: 0 .. num_labels-1 (index 0 is a COCO-id alignment placeholder with negligible probability)
score_definition.per_query: max foreground class probability of the softmax over class logits
score_definition.ranking: descending foreground score, stable ties, truncated to N=64
score_definition.shortfall_policy: fewer than 64 surviving sanitized boxes keeps the real count; never padded
